patch.value: Expose comment-only pending bot reviews in review readiness

On PR1623 the reviews-phase watcher returned a settled check inventory with no pending checks while the CodeRabbit conversation explicitly said review in progress after a requested full review. The watcher delegates only to gh pr checks, so a reviewer that reports progress solely in comments is absent from readiness. Preserve the shipped fail-fast checks phase and distinguish check completion from bot review completion.

Reproduce a terminal check rollup with an in-progress bot conversation marker; Retain exact-head check provenance and explicit reviewer limitations; Document a bounded event-driven or operator continuation without duplicate triggers or busy polling
Review readiness explicitly reports pending or unavailable comment-only reviewers and never implies their completion from a terminal check rollup.
